content.title: CBSE Result 2026: Class 10 & 12 Date, How to Check at results.cbse.nic.in
content.text: The wait is officially over! The CBSE Class 10th Results 2026 are now LIVE and accessible across all digital platforms. Students can instantly view their performance by visiting the official results portal or via the integrated DigiLocker and UMANG applications. While a surge in traffic has caused minor initial authentication delays, the servers are scaling up to ensure every student can download their digital marksheet. Whether you are checking via Roll Number or your APAAR ID, the portal is now processing requests at high speed. Celebrate your hard work and secure your digital credentials immediately for upcoming Class 11 admissions! Also Read: CBSE Class 10 Second Board Exams 2026: Who Is Eligible for Exam? CBSE Board Exam 2026 Schedule — Key Dates Exam Start Date End Date CBSE Class 12 Board Exam 2026 February 17, 2026 March 2026 CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2026 February 17, 2026 March 11, 2026 CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Late April 2026 (Expected) — CBSE Class 12 Result 2026 Late April – Mid May 2026 (Expected) — The CBSE Class 10 exams 2026 were conducted from February 17 to March 11, 2026, while the CBSE Class 12 exams 2026 commenced on February 17, 2026. With exams now concluded, the evaluation process is underway and results are expected soon. Also Read: CBSE 10th Result 2026 LIVE: Scorecard Today? Direct Link, Time & Latest Update Official Websites to Check CBSE Result 2026 Students must bookmark these official CBSE result websites to avoid fake or phishing sites: results.cbse.nic.in (Primary result portal) cbseresults.nic.in cbse.nic.in cbse.gov.in Important: Only use the above official URLs. Do NOT trust third-party websites claiming early results. The official CBSE result link will go live only on the above portals. How to Check CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 — Step-by-Step Guide Follow these easy steps to download your CBSE 10th Result 2026: Step 1: Visit the official website — results.cbse.nic.in Step 2: On the homepage, click on the 'Results' tab Step 3: Select the link that reads "CBSE Class 10 Result 2026" Step 4: Enter the following details as mentioned on your admit card: Roll Number School Number Admit Card ID Date of Birth Step 5: Click the 'Submit' button Step 6: Your CBSE 10th Result 2026 will appear on the screen with subject-wise marks and pass/fail status Step 7: Download and take a printout of the result for future reference Pro Tip: The CBSE result website may experience heavy traffic right after the announcement. If the site is slow, try DigiLocker or the UMANG App as alternatives. CBSE offers multiple platforms so students can access results conveniently even during peak server load: 1. Official Websites Visit results.cbse.nic.in, cbseresults.nic.in, cbse.nic.in, or cbse.gov.in directly. 2. DigiLocker The CBSE Result 2026 will be available on DigiLocker (digilocker.gov.in). Students can log in with their Aadhaar-linked mobile number and access their digital marksheet and passing certificate. 3. UMANG App Download the UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) app from Google Play Store or Apple App Store. Search for CBSE results and enter your credentials to view your scorecard. How to Check CBSE Class 10 Result on Umang App? 4. SMS Students can check CBSE 10th Result 2026 via SMS: Type: CBSE10 and send to 7738299899 For Class 12: Type: CBSE12 and send to 7738299899 5. IVRS (Interactive Voice Response System) Call the CBSE IVRS helpline to get your result over the phone. The number will be announced by CBSE at the time of result declaration. CBSE Class 10 Passing Marks 2026 — Minimum Marks Required CBSE Class 10 Passing Marks required to pass the CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2026, students must meet the following criteria: Component Minimum Marks Required Overall (Theory + Practical/Internal) 33% in each subject Theory Paper 27 out of 80 marks Internal Assessment / Practical 7 out of 20 marks Students who fail to secure the minimum passing marks in one or more subjects may be eligible for compartment exams, which CBSE typically conducts in July.CBSE Class 12 Passing Marks 2026 For CBSE Class 12, students must score a minimum of 33% marks in each subject (theory + practical/internal assessment combined) to be declared pass. Subject-specific minimum marks for theory and practicals apply as per the CBSE marking scheme. What After CBSE Result 2026? Next Steps for Students Class 10 students should: Download marksheet from DigiLocker (official digital document) Start researching Class 11 stream selection — Science, Commerce, or Arts Apply to schools offering preferred streams based on result Class 12 students should: Check scores and calculate percentages for college admission eligibility Apply to JEE Main, NEET, CUET 2026 counselling processes (as applicable) Start college applications — DU, JNU, BHU, private universities Apply for scholarship schemes available for meritorious students
